title: Ordinary open-extension data for the ringed sequence site
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ have object universe $c$, morphism universe $v$, a Grothendieck topology $J$, and be essentially small in $k=\max(c,v,r)$. Let $U\in\mathcal C$, let $B_n$ be commutative ring sheaves in universe $k$, and let $\tau_n:B_{n+1}\to B_n$. Use the strict semilinear system categories, evaluation and horizontal transitions of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], the localized site and restricted coefficient rings $B_n|_U$ of [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], and module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define $\operatorname{openTower}(B)_n=B_n|_U$ and $\operatorname{openTowerMap}(\tau)_n=\tau_n|_U$. Levelwise $j_{!,R}$ is the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the extension-by-zero presheaf [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf], and $j_R^*$ is restriction to $\mathcal C/U$, with their actual normalized adjunction [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. The summand section of $j_{!,R}M$ over an object of $\mathcal C/U$ is the component of this adjunction unit.

Define coefficient-comparison data to consist, for every ring-sheaf map $\varphi:R\to S$, of isomorphisms $\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi|_U}j_{!,R}\cong j_{!,S}\operatorname{Res}_\varphi$ and $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi j_R^*\cong j_S^*\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi|_U}$, the first taking every actual summand section to the identical summand section and the second the identity on underlying sections. Require compatibility with the level adjunction unit and counit, identity coefficients, and composition; the composition identifications for scalar restrictions on both sites are the identity on underlying sections.

An ordinary sequence-site open datum consists of these coefficient-comparison data and the following data. It has a ringed-topos morphism with independent site universes [def-pur-ringed-topos-morphism-of-universes] between the coefficient sequence sites, whose inverse image on underlying presheaves is naturally restriction along $(1_{\mathbb N}\times(\mathcal C/U\to\mathcal C))^{\mathrm{op}}$ and whose ring map is the identity under this identification. It has a sheaf $H$ with presheaf the constant-in-index lifted representable of $U$, a proof that $H$ is subterminal, an equivalence from sheaves on the slice sequence site to the slice topos over $H$, and an identification of this geometric inverse image with pullback to that slice. It has functors $L$ from systems on $\mathcal C$ to systems on $\mathcal C/U$ and $J_!$ in the reverse direction. The objects, maps and restrictions of $L$ are the actual section restrictions. Require an adjunction $L\dashv f_*$ to the ringed module direct image, an identification of the underlying sheaf of $L$ with geometric inverse image, an adjunction $J_!\dashv L$, and additivity and preservation of finite limits and finite colimits for both $J_!$ and $L$. Finally it has level comparisons $\operatorname{ev}_nJ_!\cong j_{!,B_n}\operatorname{ev}_n$ and $\operatorname{ev}_nL\cong j_{B_n}^*\operatorname{ev}_n$, scalar-restriction identifications between the localized composite tower maps and the restrictions of the original composite tower maps that are the identity on sections, and the two equations identifying the evaluated adjunction unit and counit with the actual level units and counits under these comparisons.

For such a datum define its transition predicate to require, for every $n\le m$ and every system $M$ on the slice, that the horizontal transition of $J_!M$, followed by the level-$n$ comparison and scalar restriction, equal the level-$m$ comparison followed by $j_{!,B_m}$ applied to the transition of $M$, the localized composite scalar identification, and the coefficient-comparison isomorphism for $B_m\to B_n$. This definition imposes the equation for equality indices as well as for all composite transitions. No existence assertion or derived extension datum is part of this definition.
